literal: احصل على جسم الشاطئ جاهزاً هذا الصيف.
back_translation: Build your Sahel (North Coast) physique this summer.
notes: Replaced the Western 'beach-body' concept with 'Faramet El Sahel' (Sahel physique), the exact Egyptian colloquial gym slang for getting in shape for the North Coast summer holidays.
